summary: extractive abstract only; no full-text synthesis

incremental.scope: Historical 1,200-paper sample sorted by publication date; 960 initial plus 240 replayed. Not a live ingest or 200k run.
incremental.assignment_method: positive-cosine weighted 5-neighbor vote over frozen Leiden labels

tier_m.scope: Linear disk-size projection for the current representations, not a measured RAM requirement; model, metadata and postings add overhead.

limitations: Recent-publication polling does not detect every historical correction or retraction.
Paid updated-date filters and paid compute are not enabled.
Incremental assignments are provisional and need full rebuild/relevance gates before promotion.
200k collection, embedding, ANN and hosted performance remain future gates.
